product_overview: A peer-to-peer skill exchange platform where users discover fictional profiles, review what others teach and want to learn, and propose 1:1 trades of time and skills. The experience includes a guided join flow, an exchange inbox, and a personal profile area for managing their presence in the network.
core_goals: Browse and filter a network of skill-exchange profiles
View individual profiles to understand what someone teaches, learns, and has traded
Propose a skill exchange with a selected partner
Complete the join flow by entering profile details and selecting teach/learn skills
Review and manage exchange proposals in an inbox
View the user's own profile and sign out

features.name: 3D Constellation Network
features.description: A homepage scene that presents 20 profiles as connected nodes in a 3D constellation, with a scroll-driven camera movement through the network.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll the homepage -> See the camera move through the network -> Hover a node -> See the profile's name
Navigate to / -> Scroll the homepage -> See Aria and Mateo highlighted as the focal nodes

features.name: 5-Act Scrollytelling Narrative
features.description: A pinned homepage story that reveals the product narrative across multiple acts as the user scrolls.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll through the homepage -> See the first act appear -> Continue scrolling -> See the next acts reveal in sequence -> Reach the community section

Navigate to / -> Scroll through the homepage -> See Aria's portrait -> Continue scrolling -> See her want-list -> Continue scrolling -> See an exchange example -> Continue scrolling -> See the community section

features.name: Discover Network
features.description: A network browser that lets users search, filter, and sort 20 profiles to find a good match.
user_flows: Navigate to /discover -> Type a name, skill, or place into search -> Click a category filter -> Change the sort order -> See the profile list update
Navigate to /discover -> Click a profile card -> See the selected person's profile page

features.name: Profile View
features.description: A single profile page that shows a person's bio, what they teach, what they want to learn, hours, trust band, and recent trades.
user_flows: Navigate to /people/:id -> Read the profile details -> Review teaches, learns, hours, trust band, and recent trades
Navigate to /people/:id -> Click Propose an exchange -> Open the exchange form for that person

features.name: Propose Exchange
features.description: A trade proposal form for selecting what the user gives, what the other person gives, and optional scheduling details.
user_flows: Navigate to /exchange/new -> Pick a skill to give -> Pick a skill to receive -> Optionally choose a date and time -> Optionally write a message -> Send the proposal -> See the inbox
Navigate to /exchange/new -> Try to submit without choosing both exchange sides -> See the form remain blocked by missing required selections

features.name: 3-Step Onboard
features.description: A guided join flow that collects identity, teach skills, and learn skills, then saves the user state and takes them to discovery.
user_flows: Navigate to /onboard -> Enter name and email -> Continue to the next step -> Select one or more skills to teach -> Continue to the final step -> Select one or more skills to learn -> Join the network -> See the discover page
Navigate to /onboard -> Leave the required identity fields incomplete -> Try to continue -> See the form prevent progress until required details are entered

features.name: Inbox
features.description: An exchange inbox with tabs for proposed, accepted, and completed trades, plus actions to progress a trade.
user_flows: Navigate to /inbox -> Open the Proposed tab -> Review incoming trade proposals -> Accept or decline a proposal
Navigate to /inbox -> Open the Accepted tab -> Review active trades -> Mark a trade complete -> See it move to completed
Navigate to /inbox -> Open the Completed tab -> Review finished trades

features.name: Me
features.description: The user's personal profile page showing their teach/learn summary, hours given and received, trust band, recent trades, and sign-out action.
user_flows: Navigate to /me -> Read the user's profile summary -> Review hours given, hours received, trust band, and recent trades
Navigate to /me -> Click sign out -> Clear the saved user state -> Return to the unauthenticated experience

features.name: Reduced-Motion Support
features.description: A calmer homepage experience where the scrolling narrative becomes a normal stacked layout when reduced motion is enabled.
user_flows: Enable reduced motion in the browser or OS -> Navigate to / -> Scroll the homepage -> See all act panels fully visible without pinned animation

features.name: Mobile Hamburger Nav
features.description: A compact mobile navigation pattern that collapses the top navigation into a hamburger menu on small screens.
user_flows: Use a viewport narrower than 720px -> Navigate to / -> Click the hamburger -> See the navigation drawer open -> Click a route link -> Navigate to that page

tech_stack.ui_library: Custom primitives (Button, Card, Chip, Field, Avatar) — no Tailwind, no MUI

tech_stack.styling: Vanilla CSS + CSS Modules + design tokens (CSS custom properties)

tech_stack.fonts: Google Fonts — Fraunces (display), Inter (body), JetBrains Mono (labels)

routes.description: Homepage with 5-act scrollytelling narrative, 3D constellation of 20 profiles, and join form
Network browser — search, category filter, sort by match/recent/active/name, 20 profile cards
Single profile view — bio, teaches, learns, hours, recent trades, propose-exchange CTA
Propose-exchange form — pick what you give and what they give, optional time and message
3-step join flow — name+email, pick teach skills, pick learn skills
Exchange inbox — tabs for proposed / accepted / completed, accept/decline/complete actions
User's own profile — teaches/learns/hours/trust, recent trades, sign-out

features.name: 3D Constellation Network
features.description: Pinned 3D scene on the homepage showing 20 profile nodes connected by skill-exchange lines; scroll-driven camera arc through the network; per-profile hues with Aria and Mateo highlighted as the focal pair
user_interactions: Scroll the homepage to see the camera move through the network
Hover a node to see its name
See Aria and Mateo as the two saturated lead nodes

features.name: 5-Act Scrollytelling Narrative
features.description: Pinned scroll experience — 4 act panels (Knows, Wants, Exchange, Community) fade in and out as the user scrolls through 500vh; reduced-motion users see the acts stacked normally
user_interactions: Scroll through the homepage to reveal each act in sequence
See Aria's portrait, then her want-list, then an exchange, then the community

features.name: Discover Network
features.description: Search and filter 20 profiles by category (Design, Code, Music, Cooking, Language, Movement, Writing, Craft); sort by best match, recent, most active, or A→Z
user_interactions: Type a name/skill/place into the search field
Click a profile card to navigate to that profile

features.name: Profile View
features.description: Single profile page showing bio, teaches, learns, hours, trust band, recent trades, and a "Propose an exchange" CTA
user_interactions: Click "Propose an exchange →" to start a trade

features.name: Propose Exchange
features.description: Form to propose a 1-hour skill exchange with another user; pre-fills first mutual match; optional scheduled time and message

features.name: 3-Step Onboard
features.description: Join the network in three steps — name+email, pick teach skills, pick learn skills; persists to localStorage and redirects to /discover on submit

user_interactions.Step 1: type name and email, click Continue

user_interactions.Step 2: click 1+ skill chips under "What you teach", click Continue

user_interactions.Step 3: click 1+ skill chips under "What you learn", click "Join the network →"

features.name: Inbox
features.description: Tabs for Proposed, Accepted, Completed trades; accept/decline/complete actions on each
user_interactions: Click Accept / Decline on a proposed trade
Click "Mark complete" on an accepted trade

features.name: Me
features.description: User's own profile, hours given/received, trust band, sign-out button
user_interactions: Click "Sign out" to clear localStorage and reset

features.name: Reduced-Motion Support
features.description: When prefers-reduced-motion is set, the 500vh pin collapses to natural scroll and all 4 act panels render fully visible without animation

features.name: Mobile Hamburger Nav
features.description: On viewports < 720px, the top nav collapses to a hamburger button; the drawer shows all routes with active-state dot

known_limitations.issue: All data is in-memory or localStorage; no real backend or API
known_limitations.impact: Trades and user state reset across devices; "completed" trades are pre-seeded for demo realism

known_limitations.issue: WebGL fallback is a static SVG, not an interactive equivalent
known_limitations.impact: Users without WebGL see a simple SVG; they still get the full DOM act narrative

known_limitations.issue: No real authentication; sign-in is localStorage-only
known_limitations.impact: A user can re-onboard with a different email and the prior user state is overwritten
